newsitem.title: FRANCE: SIDO raises French '96 sunflower crop estimate.
newsitem.headline: SIDO raises French '96 sunflower crop estimate.

text.p: The French oilseeds and protein seeds asociation SIDO raised its estimate for the 1996 sunflower crop to two million tonnes from a September target of 1.92 million and the 1.90 million produced in 1995.
The new estimate assumed a yield of 2.2 tonnes against 2.1 tonnes in September and 1.95 in 1995, SIDO said on Monday in its November report.
Area was expected to declined to 915,000 hectares from 975,000 last year.
In September SIDO put 1996 sowings at 910,000 ha.
SIDO also revised its crushings estimate up to 1.58 million tonnes from a September target of 1.50 million and 1.37 million in 1995/96.
It put carryover stocks at 266,000 tonnes. This was down from the 276,000 tonnes forecast in September but up from 256,000 on June 30, 1996.
But a higher carryover was unlikely to hit prices next year because farmers planned to sow less sunflower and more rapeseed in 1997.
"If sowings plans for the 1997 harvest are confirmed -- less sunflower and more rapeseed -- stocks of 266,000 tonnes at end June should not weigh on the upcoming campaign," SIDO said.
